experimental_contract.description: Strictly confirmatory evaluation; no model, feature, or threshold tuning permitted after test unsealing
experimental_contract.single_pass_internal_evaluation: internal_test.csv is loaded once and predictions generated once for both models
experimental_contract.production_model_immutability: models/random_forest_model.joblib remains strictly frozen and is never replaced by candidate E4

threshold_convention.definition: P(phishing) >= threshold => Phishing (label 0); P(phishing) < threshold => Legitimate (label 1)

historical_external_benchmark.evaluation_role: Historical benchmark replication (previously observed in Phase 4; NOT an independent holdout)

independent_confirmation_requirement.guidance: Genuinely independent external confirmation requires collecting and freezing a new, previously unobserved external benchmark separately.
